messages:
amanda: Hey — CI turned red on my PR but only the `integration/smoke` job failed. Can I rerun just that job and force a rebuild of artifacts (not the whole pipeline)?

jay: Yup — use the rebuild-only retry flow. From the CLI: 
```
ci retry --pr 462 --job integration/smoke --rebuild-only
```
That will re-run the job but skip upstream, relying on cached images/artifacts; it still rebuilds the job container.

amanda: Nice. Does that use the previous cache? I suspect a cache corruption might be the cause.

ricardo: By default it uses cache layers. If you want a clean rebuild try `--no-cache` with the same command: 
```
ci retry --pr 462 --job integration/smoke --rebuild-only --no-cache
```
Be aware that will be slower and may not reproduce flakes caused by infra timing.

sasha: Alternatively, if it's a single flaky test inside that job you can target the test directly instead of rebuilding. We have a helper to run the job with an override command: 
```
ci run --job integration/smoke --cmd "pytest tests/integration/test_foo.py::TestFoo::test_bar -k test_bar -q"
```
That runs on the same runner image but only executes the filtered test. Useful for debug + faster turnaround.

amanda: Sweet — I'm going to try the targeted test first, then rebuild-only if it still fails. Thanks! :thumbsup:

infra-bot: Build retry queued: PR 462, job integration/smoke, mode=rebuild-only, id=ci-172334.

amanda: Ran the targeted pytest — it passed locally and the CI run (targeted) passed too. Looks like a transient flake. Closing out. :white_check_mark:

jay: If it recurs, ping me and we can bisect across runners and tool versions (we have a `ci bisect --job ... --range` helper).
